$comment: Maps trigger-prompt source files to their Snipset database slots. Source of truth is the markdown file; the database is a derived copy. Run `bun run snippets:check` in CI to catch drift, `bun run snippets:push` to update the database. Normalization rules are documented in scripts/sync-snippets.mjs and must match on both sides, so em dashes and arrow glyphs in the source do not create false drift.
